authoringRule: Terminal stations are deliberately selected actual native mouth/bearing points. Routes and hanging height are generated, never authored by hand. lengthPolicy: Penta retains the manufacturer 60 cm loop; other lengths/radii are carried display estimates and do not imply a manufacturer load or installation specification.
